mapper.sql: a.id AS "id", a.company_id AS "company.id", IFNULL(company.name,'') AS "company.name", a.bank_bin AS "bankBin", a.bank_name AS "bankName", a.account_no AS "accountNo", a.account_name AS "accountName", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.del_flag AS "delFlag"
LEFT JOIN org_company company ON company.id = a.company_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM vietqr_config a
WHERE a.id > 0 AND a.del_flag = #{DEL_FLAG_NORMAL} AND a.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY a.update_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vietqr_config( id, company_id, bank_bin, bank_name, account_no, account_name, remarks, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{company.id}, #{bankBin}, #{bankName}, #{accountNo}, #{accountName}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, #{delFlag} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vietqr_config SET bank_bin = #{bankBin}, bank_name = #{bankName}, account_no = #{accountNo}, account_name = #{accountName}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
